# FDG7057

> DO end exception class names with the “Exception” suffix.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.4 Designing Custom Exceptions.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1710
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Test profile: none, because CA1710 also enforces the other suffixes of Table 3-5, and chapter 3 is off in the test profile. CA1710 reports a type derived from System.Exception whose name does not end with Exception, as for FDG3056 in chapter 3. Renaming a public type changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1710 has no code fix.
